sloka: स दृष्ट्वा तादृशं सैन्यं दशग्रीवो निशाचरः ।हर्षनादान्बहून्कृत्वा स क्रोधादभ्यधावत ।। ७.१४.९ ॥
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṁ sainyaṁ daśagrīvo niśācaraḥ ।harṣanādānbahūnkṛtvā sa krodhādabhyadhāvata ।। 7.14.9 ॥

translations.english: Seeing such a vast army, the demon Dashagriva, after uttering many roars of joy, rushed forward in a fit of rage.
